description: This file defines helper functions and data structures for handling Ditto Protocol messages and external messages, including building messages, converting ArrayBuffers to strings and vice versa, and wrapping ArrayBuffers into ByteBuffer objects.

methods.name: buildDittoProtocolMsg
methods.description: Constructs a Ditto Protocol message object with specified parameters.

methods.name: buildExternalMsg
methods.description: Constructs an external message object with specified headers, payloads, and content type.

methods.name: arrayBufferToString
methods.description: Converts an ArrayBuffer to a string by interpreting each byte as a character.

methods.name: stringToArrayBuffer
methods.description: Converts a string to an ArrayBuffer using 8-bit unsigned integers.

methods.name: asByteBuffer
methods.description: Wraps an ArrayBuffer into a ByteBuffer object (from bytebuffer.js library).
